template.description: Model template for this training group.

strategy.description: Training strategy used for training {@link MlModel.Train.Group#template}.

title:
Defines how to train a group of {@link MlModel}s for a group of subjects, by specifying a single template
and strategy. If multiple templates and strategies are required (e.g. cross-product), then the user should
create multiple training groups.
Used in {@link MlModel.Train.Job#groups}.

Usage:
```python
train_template = c3.MlModel.Train.Template(
    model=c3.MlModel(pipeline=..., xFeatures=..., yFeatures=...)
)
training_strategy = c3.MlModel.Train.Strategy(subjectFilter="blades == 4",
                                              start="2022-01-05",
                                              end="2022-02-05")
training_group = c3.MlModel.Train.Group(template=train_template,
                                        strategy=training_strategy)
```
name: MlModel.Train.Group
